class.name: CrazyGames
class.brief_description: What only CrazyGames has (happy time, the completion, its sign-in prompt); its ads and game events go through [Services].

method.name: get_environment
method.description: Where the SDK runs: [code]"crazygames"[/code], [code]"local"[/code] (localhost: test ads), [code]"disabled"[/code] (another site: nothing works), or empty without the SDK.

method.name: happytime
method.description: A moment of joy (a level beaten, a record): CrazyGames celebrates it with the player. Use it sparingly.

method.name: is_ad_blocked
method.description: Whether the browser blocks ads. The game must work anyway: [method Services.commercial_break] ends at once.

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Whether the SDK loaded and started on CrazyGames or on localhost.

method.name: report_game_completed
method.description: How much of the game the player has done, from 0 to 100.

method.name: show_auth_prompt
method.description: Opens CrazyGames's sign-in, when the player presses a button. The player comes through [method Services.get_player_name] and the signal [signal Services.player_changed].
